Name: Polyculture Needs More Crops
Author: Pixeltica
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hRYDrKY.png[/img]

﻿Did you ever wonder why pineapple is not needed for the Polyculture Achievement? Or why the Ancient Fruit counts for Monoculture, but again is not needed for Polyculture? Well, me neither, until someone mentioned it. Currently the Polyculture Achievement requires that you ship 15x of each of 28 listed vanilla crops ([url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Achievements]Achievements - Stardew Valley Wiki[/url] skip to avoid spoilers!) however, this list has not been updated to include additional crops introduced later on.

This mod adds all missing vanilla crops (vegetables, fruit, flowers, and some extras) to the list of crops you need to ship 15x to be awarded the Polyculture Achievement - so yes, it will make your game a little bit harder. If you do not wish to add ALL the crops you can instead choose which groups you'd like to include or exclude. Additionally, the mod also adds the missing crops as options for the Monoculture Achievement.

This mod comes with a configuration menu that you can access directly in the game via the Generic Mod Config Menu so installing this optional dependency is highly recommended to make config easier.

[b]For best experience:[/b] it is recommended that you add this mod BEFORE you achieve Polyculture in your current save, as adding it afterwards will not have any effect. Beside that it can be added and removed pretty much anytime.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/irtQu1M.png[/img]
Use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] in game to change any of the below options:

Polyculture Achievement Changes - [b]all groups enabled by default except for Sweet Gem Berry[/b], which you can choose to add for an extra challenge!
[list]
[*]Add Vanilla Vegetables
[*]Add Vanilla Fruit
[*]Add Vanilla Flowers
[*]Add Ancient Fruit
[*]Add Sweet Gem Berry 
[/list]
Monoculture Achievement Changes - [b]enabled by default[/b]
[list]
[*]Add All Missing Vanilla Crops
[/list]
Note: The Vanilla Monoculture Achievement already includes Ancient Fruit, Blue Jazz, Fairy Rose, Summer Spangle and Tulip as options

See SPOILER below for the detailed list of additions:

[spoiler] 
Vanilla Vegetables: Taro Root, Unmilled Rice, Carrots, Summer Squash, Broccoli
Vanilla Fruit: Pineapple, Cactus Fruit, Powdermelon
Vanilla Flowers: Blue Jazz, Tulip, Summer Spangle, Sunflower, Fairy Rose, Poppy
[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XynV1Qi.png[/img]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url] [[b][color=#6aa84f]COMPATIBLE[/color][/b]] Compatible with Lookup Anything as of version 1.46.1 (SDV 1.6.10 or later) Big thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato]mushymato[/url] for contributing this change!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24689]What Do You Want[/url] [[b][color=#6aa84f]COMPATIBLE[/color][/b]] you will see the newly added crops on the Polyculture requirements page right away (see example in the media images)

Other Mods [SVE, modded crops, modded machines, etc] as this targets only the Polyculture and Monoculture settings for a small number of Vanilla crops this mod should technically be compatible with everything else by default. If you do observe any issues, please do make sure to report them

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pq98yBe.png[/img]
This is my first ever published mod for Stardew Valley and though it's rather tiny in scope I had a great time putting it together.

Special thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato]mushymato[/url] for submitting the pull request for Lookup Anything to make Polyculture and Monoculture Achievement tracking dynamic.

And of course, big thanks to everyone in the Stardew Valley Discord Mod Making channel for sharing their amazing knowledge and answering all my random questions!
